edges.reason: owner is assigned tx.origin, so ownership can be hijacked through a phishing intermediary contract.
Constructor derives the privileged owner directly from tx.origin.
Unlimited allowance is granted to tx.origin and to the derived pair at deployment.
Constructor parameter flows into the base constructor for bot-protection setup.
Bot protection address parameter is stored as stopTheBots.
stopTheBots state variable receives the supplied bot-protection address.
checkBots performs an external call to the stopTheBots contract.
Modifier executes the external bot-protection call before running the function body.
External call to stopTheBots happens before transferFrom mutates balances and allowances, allowing reentrancy.
Bot-protection callback can re-enter and read/write balances before the guarded function updates them.
uniPair is encoded into the bot-protection call selector payload.
_from parameter is forwarded to the bot-protection external call.
_to parameter is forwarded to the bot-protection external call.
_value parameter is forwarded to the bot-protection external call.
notABot bool result controls the modifier require check.
Raw isNotBot returndata is returned by the low-level call.
transfer uses msg.sender as the debit source.
Recipient parameter is forwarded to transferFrom.
Amount parameter is forwarded to transferFrom.
transfer delegates all logic to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
_from parameter selects the balance and allowance entries to debit.
_to parameter selects the balance entry to credit.
_value parameter drives allowance and balance mutations.
msg.sender is compared to _from to decide whether an allowance spend is required.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is checked against _value before debiting.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performed without SafeMath, bypassing overflow checks.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value are raw unchecked operations.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf entries with unchecked arithmetic instead of SafeMath.
Spender parameter receives the new allowance.
Value parameter becomes the stored allowance amount.
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping owner slot.
delegate enforces msg.sender == owner, gating the arbitrary delegatecall.
msg.sender is the subject of the owner equality check in delegate.
Target address parameter is used as the delegatecall destination.
Arbitrary calldata parameter is passed straight into delegatecall.
delegate executes an arbitrary delegatecall that can overwrite owner and all storage.
tokenA participates in the pair address computation.
tokenB participates in the pair address computation.
token0 local holds the sorted lower address used in the hash.
token1 local holds the sorted higher address used in the hash.
Constructor result of pairOf is stored in uniPair.
distribute is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
msg.sender must equal owner to execute the mass balance overwrite.
Recipient array drives the distribution loop and external call payload.
Amount parameter is written into every targeted balanceOf entry.
Loop index iterates over the distribution address array.
distribute invokes the stopTheBots external call before iterating balances.
stopTheBots callback in distribute occurs before balanceOf entries are overwritten.
list is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
msg.sender must equal owner and also receives the 6% supply allocation.
_numList sets the contract balance and the liquidity token amount.
Recipient array drives the listing distribution loop.
Amounts array provides the values written to each balanceOf entry.
Loop index iterates over the listing arrays.
Unchecked totalSupply * 6 / 100 computes the owner allocation in list.
totalSupply is multiplied without SafeMath in the list allocation.
routerForUniswap is the target of the addLiquidityETH call.
block.timestamp + 600 is supplied as the router deadline, making the call timestamp dependent.
list derives its deadline from block.timestamp, allowing miner manipulation of the window.
list performs the router addLiquidityETH call mid-function.
External payable router call occurs before the subsequent balanceOf writes in list.
list invokes the stopTheBots external call before the balance loop.
stopTheBots callback in list executes before balanceOf entries are assigned.
totalSupply value is distributed into balanceOf entries during list.
